summary.intent: Execute the 4 gap closure plans (21-08 through 21-11) for Phase 21 (BYO IPFS node support) using the GSD wave-based parallel execution workflow, with --gaps-only filtering to run only gap_closure plans.
summary.outcome: Wave 1 completed successfully in parallel — 21-08 (BYO config wiring), 21-09 (TEE-routed connection test), and 21-10 (PinataProvider) all passed spot-checks. Wave 2 (21-11 benchmarks) was initiated after the user configured Pinata credentials, but the transcript ends before the agent completed.

repo: Pinata deprecated their PSA-compatible endpoint; a dedicated PinataProvider using Pinata v3 native API was required as a gap closure.
SDK client was instantiated at login without pinningConfig, meaning dual-pin and external-only modes never activated — fixed by loading BYO config from encrypted IPNS entry at login.
Connection tests ran in the browser and hit CORS blocks on SaaS providers; fix routes through TEE with ECIES-encrypted credentials decrypted in-enclave.
SSRF validation logic was previously embedded in migration-worker; extracted to a shared ssrf-validation.ts module during 21-09.
PinningConfig type was not exported from @cipherbox/sdk — agent auto-fixed by adding it to packages/sdk/src/index.ts.
Phase 21 execution work lives on branch docs/phase-21-context, not a dedicated phase branch (branching_strategy is none or already branched).

code.finding: Added loadByoConfig helper that reads pinningConfig from encrypted IPNS entry and injects it into SDK client at login.
Added _lastConfig state and exported reconfigurePinning function for runtime reconfiguration without full re-login.
Calls reconfigurePinning on settings save so BYO config changes take effect immediately without re-login.
Added unpinFromProvider and best-effort source unpin after verified migration transfer.
New PinataProvider implementing 5 methods (pin, unpin, status, get, pinByCid) using Pinata v3 API.
Added probePinata function and URL heuristic for auto-detecting Pinata endpoints in connection test flow.
PinataProvider instantiation added with direct-upload routing in pinWithMode.
New TEE endpoint: receives ECIES-encrypted credentials, decrypts in-enclave, probes Kubo/PSA server-side, eliminating CORS.
New shared SSRF protection module extracted from migration-worker, used by both migration and connection-test routes.
New NestJS controller adding POST /tee/connection-test endpoint.

workflow: GSD --gaps-only flag filters execution to plans with gap_closure: true in frontmatter; plans without it are skipped even if incomplete.
Wave spot-checks verify SUMMARY.md exists, key files are on disk, and at least 1 matching git commit exists before proceeding to the next wave.
Plans with autonomous: false and checkpoint type human-action cannot be auto-approved — they pause execution and require explicit user interaction regardless of auto_advance settings.
Pre-wave dependency check (gsd-tools verify key-links) runs before each wave 2+ to catch cross-plan wiring gaps early.

friction: User pasted the Pinata JWT with an extra leading 'b' character (beyJ... instead of eyJ...), causing a silent auth failure that required spotting the malformed token.
User initially tried '!' prefix syntax for shell exports which didn't execute in the session; had to switch to bash-input blocks.
Plan 21-11 requires a live external provider credential to run benchmarks, creating a human-gated checkpoint that interrupts the otherwise automated wave execution.
open_items: Plan 21-11 (BYO performance baselines against Pinata) was still executing at transcript end — results, commits, and SUMMARY.md not yet confirmed.
Pinata credentials are set as session env vars only; no indication they were persisted to .env or the project's secrets management.
Phase verification (gsd-verifier, VERIFICATION.md creation) and roadmap update not yet run — depends on 21-11 completing.
Migration source unpin in 21-08 is 'best-effort' — no retry or failure tracking if the unpin call fails after a successful migration transfer.
